name: mtp-p2-transport-92c7dc0aa-tc-a-hm0-cl
purpose: struct-close 2026-10-09 (coordinator: take p2-transport; no live variant): both 92c7dc0aa variants stopped at 4_1_cts hold repair past the buffer cap (24,044 / 23,130 buffers, hold WNS -46.6 / -52.6, 12.4k endpoints in margin) before any setup verdict: the flood rule (HM 0 at route, acceptance FF >= 0 after the post-route mm hold ECO). Same RTL / benches.

bench.name: p2cl_exact_conflict
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -Irtl/common -s tb_mtp_p2_ordered_rows -DP2_CL -DP2_CONFLICT -Ptb_mtp_p2_ordered_rows.MUT_ORDER=0 -o {RUN}/bench/m0.vvp rtl/experimental/mtp_p2_ordered_20261009/ot_mtp_p2_ordered_rows_cl.sv rtl/experimental/mtp_p2_ordered_20261009/tb_mtp_p2_ordered_rows.sv rtl/common/ot_secded.sv rtl/model/hbm_pc40_native_sim_20261003/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_sim.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/m0.vvp | tee {RUN}/bench/m0.log; grep -q 'P2 CONFLICT PASS' {RUN}/bench/m0.log && grep -q '^P2 PASS' {RUN}/bench/m0.log

bench.name: p2cl_neg_mut_order
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -Irtl/common -s tb_mtp_p2_ordered_rows -DP2_CL -Ptb_mtp_p2_ordered_rows.MUT_ORDER=1 -o {RUN}/bench/m1.vvp rtl/experimental/mtp_p2_ordered_20261009/ot_mtp_p2_ordered_rows_cl.sv rtl/experimental/mtp_p2_ordered_20261009/tb_mtp_p2_ordered_rows.sv rtl/common/ot_secded.sv rtl/model/hbm_pc40_native_sim_20261003/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_sim.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/m1.vvp | tee {RUN}/bench/m1.log; grep -q '^P2 PASS' {RUN}/bench/m1.log

calibrate.cmd: export HM=0.000; export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt; python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; P2_CL=1 bash physical/mtp_p2_transport/route.sh p2 {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}_cal $CL_STOP_AFTER --orfs-var SKIP_CTS_REPAIR_TIMING=1

route.cmd: export HM=0.000; export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt; python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; P2_CL=1 bash physical/mtp_p2_transport/route.sh p2 {LABEL} {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}

budget.reason: ActualA/SU clockplan unavailable, own calibrated generic250ps blockIO pathfinding only. RealSRAMclkq singlecycle/noMC; no production topology closure.

cycles_added: +2 edges on producer -> SRAM write (station + accept register); drain/read/queue unchanged; ~+2 cycles per P2 transaction (inside the approved +0.2 us/step)
